name: jira
description: Jira issue tracker: read and search tickets, comment, create.

settings.name: JIRA_PROJECT
settings.label: Default project key
settings.help: e.g. DBG; used when a new ticket names no project

settings.name: JIRA_AUTH
settings.label: Jira kind
settings.help: cloud: Atlassian Cloud (e-mail + API token). server: Server / Data Center (personal access token).

settings.name: JIRA_TOKEN
settings.label: API token / personal access token
settings.help: Cloud: id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens. Server/DC: Profile → Personal Access Tokens.

guidance: Ticket keys look like PROJ-123. When the user names one, read it before planning.
Use search with JQL to find related tickets, e.g. `project = DBG AND text ~ "print"`.
Commenting and creating tickets change Jira; they are writes and need the user's approval. Comment when a PR for the ticket is open.

functions.name: whoami
functions.description: Check the connection: the user the token belongs to.

functions.name: read_ticket
functions.description: Read one ticket: summary, description, status, type, priority, assignee, labels, links, sub-tasks and the latest comments.

functions.name: search
functions.description: Search tickets with JQL. Returns key, summary, status, type and assignee for each match.

functions.name: add_comment
functions.description: Add a comment to a ticket.

functions.name: create_ticket
functions.description: Create a ticket. Returns its key.

issuetype.description: e.g. Task, Bug, Story; default Task

project.description: Project key; default: the configured one
